privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we handle the limited information collected when you visit this site or get in touch.
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what little information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: Jamal Tours is a private, certified tour-guiding service based in Muscat, Sultanate of Oman. In this policy, "we", "us", and "our" refer to Jamal Tours.
If you have any questions about this policy or your information, contact us at jamal3929@hotmail.com.

sections.heading: Information we collect
body: We deliberately keep data collection to a minimum. This website has no sign-up, no user accounts, and no online payment.

Information you share with us: when you contact us through WhatsApp, email, or Instagram, we receive whatever details you choose to send — typically your name, your contact details, and the details of the trip you are planning.

Information collected automatically: like most websites, our hosting provider records basic technical data such as your IP address, browser type, and the pages you view, and we use privacy-friendly, aggregated visitor analytics. This does not identify you personally, and we do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: How we use your information
body: To respond to your enquiries and arrange the tours you request.
To operate, maintain, and improve this website.
We do not sell your information, and we do not use it for advertising.

sections.heading: Third-party services
body: When you contact us through WhatsApp (Meta) or Instagram, or when this site is served through our hosting provider (Vercel), your information is also handled under those companies' own privacy policies. We recommend reviewing them.
This website may link to third-party platforms; we are not responsible for their content or their privacy practices.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: We keep the messages and details you send only for as long as needed to arrange your tour and for reasonable follow-up, after which they are deleted or archived.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You may ask us to access, correct, or delete the personal information you have shared with us. To make a request, email jamal3929@hotmail.com and we will respond within a reasonable time.
If you are visiting from the European Union, the United Kingdom, or another region with data-protection laws, you may have additional rights under those laws.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
body: This website is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information from children. Tour bookings are made by adults on behalf of their party.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised.

sections.heading: Contact us
body: For any privacy question or request, email jamal3929@hotmail.com or reach us using the details on our Contact page.

terms.title: Terms & Booking Conditions
terms.subtitle: The terms that apply when you book and take a tour with Jamal Tours.
terms.intro: Please read these terms carefully. By booking or taking part in a tour with Jamal Tours, you agree to the conditions below.

sections.heading: Booking and enquiries
body: Tours are arranged directly with Jamal by WhatsApp, phone, or email. Sending an enquiry does not by itself confirm a booking.
Your booking is confirmed only once we have agreed the date, itinerary, and price with you and confirmed it in writing (for example, by WhatsApp message).

sections.heading: Prices and payment
body: Prices shown on this website are starting ("from") prices in US dollars and may vary with the itinerary, group size, season, and any extra services requested.
The final price is the one we confirm with you at the time of booking.
The payment method and any deposit are agreed directly with Jamal when you book.

sections.heading: Cancellations and changes
body: If you need to cancel or change your booking, please tell us as early as possible so we can do our best to accommodate you.

We may need to change or cancel a tour for reasons of safety, weather, road or site closures, or other circumstances beyond our control (for example, the Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque is closed to visitors on Fridays). Where this happens, we will offer a suitable alternative date or itinerary where possible.

sections.heading: What's included and excluded
body: Unless stated otherwise, each tour includes a private vehicle, drinking water, and a certified private guide.
Prices exclude personal expenses, meals unless specified, souvenirs, and entrance fees to sites unless we have expressly included them.

sections.heading: Your responsibilities
body: Please be ready at the agreed time and place, and carry any valid identification or visa required for travel in Oman.
Dress modestly when visiting mosques and religious or cultural sites, and follow your guide's instructions at all times, particularly regarding safety.

sections.heading: Health, safety, and assumption of risk
body: Our tours may include outdoor and water-based activities such as swimming in wadis, hiking, desert excursions, and boat trips. These activities carry inherent risks.

You take part in all activities at your own risk and are responsible for judging whether an activity is suitable for you and your party. Please tell us in advance about any medical conditions, injuries, or special requirements.
We strongly recommend that every guest holds valid travel and medical insurance covering the activities on their tour.

sections.heading: Liability
body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Jamal Tours is not liable for injury, loss, or damage arising from participation in a tour, except where caused by our proven negligence.
We are not responsible for services provided by independent third parties (such as boat operators, restaurants, or attraction sites), nor for events beyond our reasonable control (force majeure).

sections.heading: Conduct
body: For the safety and enjoyment of everyone, we may end a tour without refund if a guest behaves unsafely, unlawfully, or in a way that seriously disrupts the tour or endangers others.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Sultanate of Oman, and any dispute will be subject to the jurisdiction of the Omani courts.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when they were last revised. The terms in force at the time of your booking apply to that booking.

sections.heading: Contact us
body: For any question about these terms or your booking, email jamal3929@hotmail.com or use the details on our Contact page.
